name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: 25 years after 9/11, Taliban rules Afghanistan again, but with U.S. firepower
changes.summary: CBS News finds Taliban forces patrolling Kabul in American armored vehicles, wearing American tactical gear and carrying American weapons.

changes.title: U.S. envoy warns U.K. against new plan to sanction Israeli settlements
changes.summary: Britain and 11 other U.S. allies say they'll sanction trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, citing an "unprecedented level of settler violence.".

changes.title: Goldman Sachs warns oil prices could hit $120 as U.S. fuel costs surge
changes.summary: Higher gas and diesel prices have cost Americans an additional $100 billion since the Iran war began, according to a Brown University tracker.

changes.title: Small plane goes missing off Bahamas carrying 4 members of Florida family
changes.summary: A small plane carrying four family members flying back home to Florida went missing off the Bahamas, the U.S. Coast Guard and authorities in the Bahamas said.

changes.title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
changes.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
changes.summary: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight. (Image credit: Roberto Schmidt).

changes.title: Current events: Scientists keep close eye on Atlantic Ocean changes
changes.summary: The year is 2060. London shudders through months of Nordic winter freezes. Across northern Europe, oak and beech forests wither under severe frost and drought, while cereal yields collapse from temperatures plunging as low as 27 degrees Fahrenheit below today's averages. In U.S. coastal cities such as Miami and Charles.

changes.title: Canada Imposes New Tariffs on U.S. Goods, as Trade War Intensifies
changes.summary: The duties are a retaliation against President Trump’s recent tariffs, raising concerns about further escalation.

changes.title: Bombardier, a Canadian Jet Maker, Is One Target in Trump’s Trade War
changes.summary: The Montreal-based manufacturer has been embroiled in U.S. trade disputes before. President Trump threatened to bar the company from selling in the United States.

changes.title: Iceland Summons U.S. Ambassador Over Provocative Trump Map
changes.summary: After voting against talks to join the European Union, Iceland is reacting forcefully to a slight against its sovereignty.
